photos.why: Printed title. Curved stairs and marble bridge as S02 pp.147-148. The small domed pavilion at the far left (west) has no named id; XY06-B0151 is the only block on the plan to the west, position only. Curved scroll balustrades in the foreground fit the plan row with flaring wings 28 m south.

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Retired in Round 6, no box: Not a building. A figure with a narrow centre and two flaring ends, 16 x 10 m as drawn, in the garden south of the moat, 15 m off the axis. Plates 8 and 9 show parterres with scrollwork and no building here; plate 8 lower right has one such bed. Nothing clear on the ruin at the row, which is on the moat's bank. (S01, Round 6).

facts.label: Plan reader's note
facts.value: rect=77,46,0. Cross-shaped centre 30 px wide with two flaring wings. Off the 方外观 axis by 73 px. Could be a planted bed or pool. Not the 五竹亭 of engraving 9.
